module priority_encoder_4to2 (
    input  [3:0] in,
    output [1:0] out,
    output       valid
);

assign valid   = |in;               // Valid signal is high if any input is high
assign out[1] = in[3] | in[2];    // High when D3 or D2 (with higher priority) is active
assign out[0] = in[3] | (in[1] & ~in[2]); // High when D3 or D1 (with higher priority) is active

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input w,
  input R,
  input E,
  input L,
  output reg Q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (E) begin
      if (L) begin
        Q <= R;
      end else begin
        Q <= w;
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input p1a,
  input p1b,
  input p1c,
  input p1d,
  output p1y,
  input p2a,
  input p2b,
  input p2c,
  input p2d,
  output p2y
);

  assign p1y = p1a && p1b && p1c && !p1d;
  assign p2y = p2a && p2b && p2c && !p2d;

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [7:0] code,
  output reg [3:0] out,
  output reg valid
);

always @(*) begin
  case (code)
    8'b00000001: begin out = 4'd1;  valid = 1'b0; end
    8'b00000010: begin out = 4'd2;  valid = 1'b0; end
    8'b00000100: begin out = 4'd3;  valid = 1'b0; end
    8'b00001000: begin out = 4'd4;  valid = 1'b0; end
    8'b00010000: begin out = 4'd5;  valid = 1'b0; end
    8'b00100000: begin out = 4'd6;  valid = 1'b0; end
    8'b01000000: begin out = 4'd7;  valid = 1'b0; end
    8'b10000000: begin out = 4'd8;  valid = 1'b0; end
    default:      begin out = 4'bx;  valid = 1'b1; end
  endcase
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
  if (reset) begin
    q <= 4'b0;
  end else begin
    if (q == 4'd9) begin
      q <= 4'b0;
    end else begin
      q <= q + 1'b1;
    end
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input slowena,
  input reset,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin
  if (reset) begin
    q <= 4'b0000;
  end
  else if (slowena) begin
    if (q == 4'b1001) begin
      q <= 4'b0000;
    end
    else begin
      q <= q + 1;
    end
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input enable,
  input S,
  input A,
  input B,
  input C,
  output reg Z
);

  reg [5:0] stack;

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (enable) begin
      stack <= {stack[4:0], S};
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    if (C) begin
      Z = stack[5];
    end else if (B) begin
      Z = stack[4];
    end else if (A) begin
      Z = stack[0];
    end else begin
      Z = 1'bx;
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input shift_ena,
  input count_ena,
  input data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (shift_ena && count_ena) begin
      q <= 4'b1111;
    end else if (shift_ena) begin
      q <= {data, q[3:1]};
    end else if (count_ena) begin
      q <= q - 1;
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input areset,
  input load,
  input ena,
  input [3:0] data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
    if (areset) begin
      q <= 4'b0;
    end else begin
      if (load) begin
        q <= data;
      end else if (ena) begin
        q <= {1'b0, q[3:1]};
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input [31:0] in,
  output [31:0] out
);

  assign out = { in[7:0],   // out[31:24] (8 bits)
                   in[15:8],  // out[23:16] (8 bits)
                   in[23:16],  // out[15:8] (8 bits)
                   in[31:24]};  // out[7:0] (8 bits)

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input a,
  output reg [2:0] q
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (a) begin
      q <= 3'd1;
    end else begin
      if (q == 3'd6) begin
        q <= 3'd1;
      end else begin
        q <= q + 3'd2;
      end
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input in,
  input [9:0] state,
  output [9:0] next_state,
  output out1,
  output out2
);

  assign out1 = |state[4:0];  // OR of bits 0-4
  assign out2 = |state[7:0];  // OR of bits 0-7
  assign next_state = in ? state : 10'b0;

endmodule
